patthana19.15:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca bahiddhā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana19.15:2.1: na bahiddhā dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana19.15:4.1: na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, dve.
patthana19.15:5.1: na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, dve.
